relevance_note: Case report of three related patients with Blau syndrome and a NOD2 variant: "identified all the three patients to carry a c. 1000C >T/p. Arg334Trp (R334W) heterozygous variant in the NOD2 gene".
method_note: Hand-built from a full read of the short case report; a Python script in the scratch directory only assembled the JSON. No person has a label in the paper and role words are not labels, so the mother (first mentioned) is 'unnamed person 1' (rule 6) and the children are labelled by rule 2 with the relation as written ('The first child, a boy', 'The second child, a girl'). is_proband left null: no one is called proband/index case and this is not a single-patient report. Inheritance for both children recorded as 'inherited maternal' because the paper states that the mother carries the same heterozygous NOD2 variant (D-24); the mother's own inheritance is not reported. Fever excluded for all three and RF/ANA/HLA-B27 positivity excluded for all three from statements naming the group ('any of our patients', 'All three patients'). 'Chest X-ray was normal and Mantoux was negative. Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) levels were also within normal limits.' does not name the person(s) tested, so no rows were made from it. The Discussion sentence 'It is also likely that ... the typical boggy arthritis and rash were not present at the time of presentation' is hedged and refers to the mother and first child jointly; it was not used to exclude rash or arthritis. Flexion contractures / contracture at the PIP joints (mother; boy, from the Figure 2 legend) were recorded verbatim as features and mapped to the checklist item camptodactyly; the paper does not use the word camptodactyly and attributes the mother's contractures to previous arthritis. The girl's age at onset is left not reported: the paper gives only her age at presentation (3 years), recorded as onset of the uveitis feature. Ages at last evaluation are the ages at report ('now 10 years', 'now 5 years', '38-year-old'). Country 'India' is taken from the authors' statement that this is a case series from India. The variant is printed with spaces as 'c. 1000C >T/p. Arg334Trp'; recorded verbatim with no transcript. No contradictions found.
